## // Standards

MARC21 Format for Bibliographic Data  - [LoC](https://www.loc.gov/marc/bibliographic) // [DNB](https://www.dnb.de/marc21) // [OCLC](https://www.oclc.org/bibformats/en/about.html)  
[KBART](https://www.niso.org/standards-committees/kbart) - Knowledge Bases and Related Tools Recommended Practice  
[ONIX](https://www.editeur.org/8/ONIX/) for Books Product Information Message  
[ISBD](https://www.ifla.org/international-standard-bibliographic-description) - International Standard Bibliographic Description  
[JATS - Journal Article Tag Suite // BITS](https://jats.nlm.nih.gov)
